scope: NekoClaw plugin direct dispatch and capability-gateway plugin calls when POST /runs has an ambiguous transport outcome.

native_gap.client: nekoclaw/host/plugin_runs.py builds POST /runs with task_id, plugin_id, entry_id and args, but does not send RunCreateRequest.idempotency_key. Its transport exception path returns run_failed even though the request may already have created a run.
native_gap.server: plugin/_types/models.py already defines RunCreateRequest.idempotency_key. plugin/runs/manager.py create_run uses create_or_get_idempotent so an immediate retry with the same key returns the original run instead of executing the entry twice.
native_gap.native_proof: plugin/tests/unit/server/test_run_manager_idempotency.py::test_retry_after_lost_response_executes_once proves the server primitive already closes the duplicate-effect side of a lost-response retry.
native_gap.effect_risk: Without consuming the native key, a lost create response is indistinguishable from no run being created. Treating it as ordinary failure permits later task retry/re-dispatch while the first plugin run may already have produced an external effect.

reuse_order.candidate: N.E.K.O current pin PluginRunner + plugin /runs protocol
reuse_order.reason: Both task-brain direct plugin execution and capability-gateway plugin execution already converge on PluginRunner.run_entry.
No newer upstream client wiring exists at review time.

reuse_order.candidate: N.E.K.O Plugin SDK / PluginStore run protocol
reuse_order.reason: The existing RunCreateRequest.idempotency_key and RunStore create_or_get_idempotent are the exact native primitive needed; no new store or protocol is required.
The ambiguous effect occurs between NekoClaw and N.E.K.O's own plugin server; no pinned surface/provider component owns this run-creation boundary.

reuse_order.candidate: External idempotency middleware / workflow engines / durable queues
reuse_order.reason: They would add another durability authority around a protocol that already has an exact native idempotency primitive.
Use the already-reserved host call identity as the existing run protocol's idempotency key and retry only ambiguous create outcomes with that same key.

reuse_order.candidate: Private idempotency store or XiaoYu run ledger
reuse_order.reason: Would duplicate N.E.K.O's RunStore and host call audit.

candidate_contract.stable_identity_source: call_audit.Call.call_id reserved before the plugin call
candidate_contract.retry_scope: Only create outcomes that are ambiguous after request submission (transport exception, malformed successful response, or server 5xx) may be retried, and only with the identical idempotency key.
candidate_contract.non_retry_scope: Explicit 4xx/refusal remains terminal for that attempt. Calls without a host audit identity keep existing non-retry behavior.
candidate_contract.authority: N.E.K.O plugin RunStore remains the sole dedupe authority; XiaoYu stores no idempotency state.
candidate_contract.effect_rule: UNKNOWN create outcome must not be converted into a fresh unkeyed execution.

machine_acceptance: The real plugin run manager test for lost-response idempotency remains green.
A real FakePluginServer using production /runs routes receives two POST attempts with the same non-empty idempotency_key after the first accepted response is dropped.
Only one plugin entry execution occurs and only one run record exists.
PluginRunner returns the original successful run rather than run_failed.
A call without audit identity does not silently gain a retry/dedupe contract.
Existing cancellation/polling and gateway regressions remain green.
promotion_policy: candidate_only_until_machine_gate_and_regression_evidence; promotion also requires an available managed-patch budget slot or equivalent upstream N.E.K.O adoption.
retirement_condition: Delete the candidate when upstream N.E.K.O PluginRunner natively sends a stable per-host-call idempotency key and safely retries ambiguous POST /runs creation outcomes with equivalent lost-response, no-duplicate-effect and regression coverage.
conclusion: THIN_NATIVE_WIRING_CANDIDATE. Reuse the existing plugin run idempotency primitive; do not create another ledger, store, queue, router or daemon.
